alt: A screenshot of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services Office for Civil Rights Complaint Portal, showing the 'Signature' step of a Health Information Privacy, Security, & Breach Notification Complaint form.
summary:
This document is a screenshot of the 'Signature' section of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) Office for Civil Rights (OCR) Complaint Portal for Health Information Privacy, Security, & Breach Notification. The page outlines the voluntary nature of filing a complaint, the legal authority under which information is collected (Enforcement Rule, 45 CFR part 160, and HIPAA), and assurances regarding confidentiality under the Privacy Act of 1974. It also provides instructions for submitting complaints electronically or via mail, along with contact information for the OCR.

The legal significance of this document lies in its role as a formal mechanism for individuals to report potential violations of the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and related privacy regulations. It emphasizes the protection against retaliation for filing a complaint or participating in an investigation, and clarifies that submitted information is treated confidentially. The presence of an OMB Control Number (0945-0002) and an expiration date (05/31/2029) indicates that this is an officially approved government form, subject to review and renewal. The 'Burden Statement' informs users about the estimated time required to complete the form and provides an avenue for feedback on the information collection process.

No significant discrepancies were found between the image and the OCR text. The OCR accurately captured all visible text, including the navigation tabs (Complainant, Complaint Details, Additional Information, Signature, Consent, Review and Submit), the active 'Signature' tab, the instructions for signing the complaint, the legal disclaimers, the burden statement, and the agreement/decline options. The contact information for accommodations and the HHS address are also correctly transcribed.

U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
Office for Civil Rights
Complaint Portal: Health Information Privacy, Security, & Breach Notification
Complaint Portal - File a Health Information Privacy, Security, & Breach Notification Complaint
To file a complaint, please enter information in the wizard pages below. A field with an asterisk (*) before it is a required field.
Complainant
Complaint Details Additional Information
Signature Consent
Review and Submit
Please sign this complaint.
• Welcome Home | HHS | Office for Civil Rights | About Us | Contact Us
Form Approved: OMB No. 0945-0002
Expiration Date: 05/31/2029
Filing a complaint with OCR is voluntary. However, without the information requested above, OCR may be unable to proceed with your complaint. We collect this information under authority of the Enforcement Rule (45 CFR part 160) issued pursuant
to the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA). A HIPAA covered entity or business associate may not threaten, intimidate, coerce, harass discriminate against, or take any other retaliatory action against any individual for
filing a HIPAA complaint or participating in a HIPAA investigation (45 CFR 160.316). We will use the information you provide to determine if we have jurisdiction and, if so, how we will process your complaint. Information submitted on or through this
form is treated confidentially and is protected under the provisions of the Privacy Act of 1974. Names or other identifying information about individuals may be disclosed when it is necessary for investigation, for internal systems operations, or for
routine uses, which include disclosure of information outside the HHS for purposes associated with statutory compliance and as permitted by law. You are not required to use this form. You also may write a letter or submit a complaint electronically with
the same information. To submit an electronic complaint, go to OCR's web site at: https://www.hhs.gov/hipaa/filing-a-complaint/complaint-process/index.html. To mail a complaint, please send to HHS Office for Civil Rights, Centralized Case
Management Operations, 200 Independence Ave., S.W. Suite 515F, HHH Building, Washington, D.C. 20201.
Burden Statement
Public reporting burden for the collection of information on this complaint form is estimated to average 45 minutes per response, including the time for reviewing instructions, gathering the data needed and entering and reviewing the information on the
completed complaint form. An agency may not conduct or sponsor, and a person is not required to respond to, a collection of information unless it displays a valid control number. Send comments regarding this burden estimate or any other aspect of
this collection of information, including suggestions for reducing this burden, to: HHS/OS Reports Clearance Officer, Office of Information Resources Management, 200 Independence Ave. S.W., Room 531H, Washington, D.C. 20201. Please do not
mail complaint form to this address.
* After reading the above information, please check ONLY ONE of the following boxes:
☐
AGREE: I have read, understand, and agree to the above.
DECLINE: I have read and understand the above. But I do not agree with it.
← Back
Next
If you are an individual with a disability and require an accommodation to access OCR services, language interpreter services, or if you would like to be provided with this Complaint Form in another language please contact our Customer Response Center: 1-800-368-1019 (voice) or TDD: 800-537-7697; you may also send an email message to
OCRMail@hhs.gov or fax to (202) 619-3818.
